# AIBgin — an AIB for schools (in development)
> A teacher's AIB that knows what every student already knows. AIBgin is in development and being built on AIB.core, the engine behind AIBEVA.

## Key facts
- Status: in development. Not yet available.
- Idea: an intelligent being per student that builds on what the student already knows.
- Safe by design, with the Guardian layer (AIBguardian) inside; roles for school and family; EU AI Act and GDPR by design.
- Interested for your school? info@aiblab.info
- AIBEVA (for adults, 18+) is free for Windows today: https://aibeva.com/download
- Operator: SAY TO PAY s.r.o. (AIBlab), Ostrava, Czech Republic, EU · Company ID 086 94 222
